title: ERP vendor-payment execution evidence (P0-04B ERP-B, ADR-SHARED-038)
description: The independently verified fact that a vendor disbursement was already executed outside ERP. ERP classifies an outbound payment into erp.vendor-payment.record only when it is bound to exactly one such record naming the same placement (and so the same responsible legal entity), payee, amount, currency and originating vendor-invoice obligation, and not already bound to another payment. Evidence is never an instruction, never money-movement authority and never accounting authority: a current CP posting-authority decision is still required. The execution-authority vocabulary is closed; its only value in this revision is SYNTHETIC_ENGINE_LOCAL, which proves the mechanism on synthetic data and never that a real disbursement happened. Native vendor identifiers never cross this boundary: payee and obligation are opaque ERP references.

erpReference.description: Opaque ERP-issued reference. ERP resolves it to its own native record within the named placement; it never carries a native client, organisation or table identifier.

executionAuthority.description: Closed vocabulary of approved execution authorities. SYNTHETIC_ENGINE_LOCAL is admissible only in engine-local harnesses on synthetic data. A real authority (for example a Payments payout execution, ADR-SHARED-035) needs its own versioned revision; until then vendor-payment recording is non-activatable for protected and production placements.

responsible_legal_entity_id.description: The payer. Must equal the legal entity of the named placement version.

payee_reference.description: The supplier paid, as an opaque ERP business-partner reference.

obligation_reference.description: The originating obligation: a vendor invoice of class erp.vendor-invoice.record in the same placement. The payment may be allocated only to it.

amount.description: Positive decimal amount executed, in currency units.

verified_at.description: When the execution authority's observation was verified; never before executed_at.

verified_by.description: Accountable verifier. Never a generic system or automation actor.
